consistency_check_level0.meaning: The static code and Palace's eigensolver agree on the same mesh within the predicted window. In a QUALIFIED record, S'_h is then reported under the name H_h, Palace's complete harmonic moment on the nested meshes under the identity; for levels 1 and 2 it is the moment Palace would have if given those meshes.

C.bracket_assumption: two terms, orders 1 and q in (1, 2], coefficients of one sign
C.reason: observed order within [1, 2]; level 2 not within tau of the model limit
C.bound_basis: Applies to upper_bound_fF (C, C') and lower_bound_GHz2 (S, the second moment) ONLY. The Dirichlet principle: C <= C_2 (1 + certified error), certified relative to the assembled operator up to rho (method.certificate). The uncertified assembly round-off is reported beside each bound as assembly_term_estimate_rel_at_level2 = max|phi|^2 sum|K - K_ld| / E_2 (sum from the preflight): an estimate, not a certificate. A limit bracket, where given, is MODEL-BASED and carries its bracket_assumption; it is not covered by this basis.
